skill.name: amap-lbs-skill
skill.description: Search AMap places, plan routes, create travel plans, and generate map visualization links using AMap services.
skill.summary: Search AMap places and plan routes with AMap Web Service APIs.
skill.author: AMap-Web

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from JavaScript template literals, Markdown backticks, Chinese prose entropy, and fixed relative imports. Confirmed risks are intended AMap network calls, local config file access for API keys, environment variable access, HTTP heatmap links, and telemetry curl instructions in SKILL.md. No prompt injection attempt was found in the inspected files.

remediation.suggestion: Remove the log/init curl steps or require explicit user consent before sending telemetry.
Prefer environment variables or an OS secret store, and set restrictive permissions if config.json is used.
Disclose that place, route, coordinate, data URL, and API key values are sent to AMap services.
Use HTTPS heatmap URLs when supported, or warn users before generating HTTP links that include dataUrl values.

content.user_title: Search AMap Places and Plan Routes
content.value_statement: Finding reliable Chinese map places and routes can require several AMap API calls. This skill guides POI search, route planning, travel planning, and map visualization.
actual_capabilities: Builds AMap search links for direct keyword or place queries.
Calls AMap Web Service APIs for POI search and route planning.
Supports walking, driving, cycling, and public transit route modes.
Generates map visualization links from POI and route data.
Provides command-line scripts for POI search, routes, and travel planning.
Reads API keys from environment variables or a local config file.
limitations: Requires a valid AMap Web Service API key for API-based features.
Sends place, route, coordinate, and key data to AMap endpoints.
Stores API keys in a local plain text config file when configured that way.
Coverage and quotas depend on AMap account permissions and service limits.

use_cases.title: Local Search Support
use_cases.description: Find restaurants, hotels, landmarks, or services in a selected city and return AMap search links.

use_cases.title: Route Planning
use_cases.description: Compare walking, driving, cycling, or transit routes between known coordinates.

use_cases.title: Trip Drafting
use_cases.description: Collect POIs by interest and assemble a simple city itinerary for map review.

prompt_templates.title: Find a Place
prompt_templates.prompt: Search AMap for coffee shops in Hangzhou and give me the search link.

prompt_templates.title: Search Nearby
prompt_templates.prompt: Find hotels within 1000 meters of Shanghai Hongqiao Railway Station. Ask for my AMap key if needed.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Route
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a driving route from 116.397428,39.90923 to 116.427281,39.903719. Include distance, time, and map link.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Day Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a one-day Beijing plan for museums, lunch, and parks. Use walking routes where possible and summarize each stop.

output_examples.output: An AMap search link with a short note that the user can open it to view mapped results.

output_examples.input: Plan a walking route between two coordinates.
output_examples.output: Route mode, estimated distance, estimated time, and an AMap visualization link when data is available.

output_examples.input: Make a Hangzhou food and tea route.
output_examples.output: A list of suggested POIs grouped by interest, followed by a simple route summary.

best_practices: Ask before sending user data or API keys to AMap.
Prefer environment variables over local config files for API keys.
Verify coordinates and city names before calling route APIs.
anti_patterns: Do not paste AMap API keys into chat transcripts or public files.
Do not use the telemetry curl steps without clear user consent.
Do not treat generated map links as proof that a route is safe or accessible.

faq.question: Does this skill require an API key?
faq.answer: Yes. Detailed POI search, geocoding, routing, and travel planning require an AMap Web Service API key.

faq.question: Which map provider does it use?
faq.answer: It uses AMap, also known as Gaode Map, through public links and Web Service APIs.

faq.question: Can it plan routes?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports walking, driving, cycling, and public transit route requests when valid coordinates are supplied.

faq.question: Does it store credentials?
faq.answer: It can store a Web Service key in config.json. Environment variables are safer for shared machines.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, or Claude Code use it?
faq.answer: Yes. The metadata lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.

faq.question: Does it send telemetry?
faq.answer: The skill instructions include AMap log requests. Users should approve those requests before they run.
